## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage5 parameter sweep seeks to capture intraday mean-reversion or momentum scalps by optimizing exit parameters (TP/SL, time stop, chandelier arm) and entry filters (strike offset, volume ratio). The edge hypothesized is that tighter exits with volume confirmation reduce whipsaws while allowing runners to develop, particularly on high-conviction bearish rejection days.

## Mechanism

- **Entry:** Requires volume ratio ≥ 1.2 (current bar volume vs 20-bar average) and bearish setup (implied by context, though entry logic not detailed in keeper JSON).  
- **Exit:**  
  - Take profit at 75% of entry premium (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`)  
  - Stop loss at 35% of entry premium (`stop_premium_pct=-0.35`)  
  - Time stop at 12 minutes (`time_stop_min=12`)  
  - Chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% of favorable move (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`)  
- **Contract selection:** Strike offset = 2 (likely 2 strikes OTM for puts based on bearish focus)
